statement: SpaceX expects roughly 90% of its compute to serve inference or be rented to others, with only about 10% used for Grok training, and it holds multibillion-dollar AI capacity leases with Google and Anthropic.
why: An overwhelmingly inference- and rental-weighted fleet means GPU demand here is tied to paid token serving and third-party leases, not just internal research budgets.

impact.mechanism: Inference and rental utilization ties accelerator demand to revenue-generating workloads and external leases, making the buildout self-funding rather than speculative.

evidence.excerpt: I would expect maybe 10% of our compute to be used for Grok training
SpaceX has multibillion-dollar leasing agreements with Google and Anthropic for AI capacity rental at the Colossus data center.

confidence.basis: Hedged CEO estimate plus corroborating coverage, both relayed in secondary sources.
